test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following pie chart shows the population of 7 villages.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b77b876e7877757586824b0aaac00709f69569db33eb86b8a6707d9b7d1f904d.png] 

If the total population of all the villages together is 50,000 , what is the population of village D?
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b77b876e7877757586824b0aaac00709f69569db33eb86b8a6707d9b7d1f904d.png] 

Total population is 50000

**Calculations:**

According to question,

Population of Village D = (17/100) × 50000

= 8500

**Hence, The Required value is 8500.**
